statement.zh: 将锡拉喷发简单定为 LM IB 全面崩溃的唯一或主因，仍属可争议模型（Troubled Island 亦强调多因与区域差异）。
statement.en: Treating the Theran eruption as the sole or primary cause of a blanket LM IB collapse remains contested (Troubled Island itself stresses multicausality and regional difference).

disclaimer: Hypothesis / scholarly model — not established fact. Labelled kind=hypothesis.
